# CANDIDATE: VWAP_PULLBACK_WITH_RSI_BOOST

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Pullbacks to VWAP combined with an extreme RSI reading provide a high‑probability mean‑reversion entry within the intraday trend. The edge exists because VWAP acts as dynamic support/resistance and RSI extremes signal overextension that is likely to revert.

## Mechanism

Establish intraday uptrend when price > VWAP and EMA20 > EMA50; downtrend when price < VWAP and EMA20 < EMA50. In an uptrend, enter long when the low touches VWAP within ±0.1% (low ≥ VWAP×0.999 and low ≤ VWAP×1.001) and RSI(14) < 30, then buy at the open of the next bar. In a downtrend, enter short when the high touches VWAP within ±0.1% and RSI > 70, then sell at the open of the next bar. Exit: stop at the most recent swing point prior to the VWAP touch (prior low for longs, prior high for shorts). Target at 2× risk or trail using 15% of ATR from the highest‑since‑entry watermark. Regime hint: optimal when VIX is between 15 and 25; avoid very low VIX (<12) where VWAP bands are too tight and very high VIX (>30) where mean‑reversion fails.
